text_block_list.text:
Brushing off her weakness over distance to 
seize the win, Sakura Bakushin O was 
pumped and ready to take on the Classics.

However, her Trainer, wishing to make the 
most of her speed, persuades Sakura 
Bakushin O to enter the Aoi Stakes.

Deeply moved by her Trainer's desire to 
pursue pure speed, Sakura Bakushin O set 
her next goal on the Aoi Stakes.
